intro.en: Custom FTDI cable assemblies combine a USB interface, conversion electronics, serial-side signal definition and a purpose-built cable harness. Chip family, logic level, serial standard, pinout, connector, protection, driver behavior and validation are reviewed as one product.
intro.zh: 定制 FTDI 电缆组件把 USB 接口、转换电子器件、串行端信号定义与专用线束结合在一起。芯片家族、逻辑电平、串行标准、针脚、接口、防护、驱动行为与验证需要作为一个产品整体审核。

knowledge.en: An FTDI cable is an active electronic assembly. A familiar USB, header, RJ45, DB9 or M12 connector does not prove the protocol, voltage level, pin map or driver identity.
knowledge.zh: FTDI 线缆属于有源电子组件。熟悉的 USB、排针、RJ45、DB9 或 M12 外形，并不能证明协议、逻辑电平、针脚表或驱动身份。

notes.en: Provide the host USB port, target equipment and connector, exact pin map, serial electrical standard, I/O voltage, required signals, power policy, operating system, driver/API, protection, length, environment, quantity and acceptance method.
notes.zh: 请提供主机 USB 接口、目标设备与连接器、准确针脚表、串行电气标准、I/O 电平、所需信号、供电策略、操作系统、驱动/API、防护、长度、环境、数量与验收方法。

delivery.en: Release records identify the approved electronics, programmed configuration, cable and endpoint BOM, circuit map, mechanical build, labels and agreed electrical and functional tests. Component or firmware substitutions require review.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录批准的电子器件、编程配置、线缆与端点 BOM、回路图、机械结构、标签，以及约定的电气与功能测试；器件或固件替代需要重新审核。

subtitle.en: USB on one side. A precisely defined serial interface on the other.
subtitle.zh: 一端是 USB，另一端必须是被准确说明的串行接口

lead.en: The cable body may look simple, but it can contain a USB-to-UART bridge, level adaptation, protection and programmed identity. A reliable custom assembly begins with the target equipment and software path—not with connector appearance.
lead.zh: 线缆外观看似简单，内部却可能包含 USB-UART 桥接、逻辑电平适配、保护与已编程身份。可靠的定制组件应从目标设备和软件路径出发，而不是从接口外观开始。

title.en: An Active Converter Cable, Not a Passive Wire Map
title.zh: 它是有源转换线，不是被动针脚线

copy.en: A USB-to-serial cable receives USB packets at the host, converts them through an interface IC and presents UART or another serial electrical interface at the equipment end. The electronics may sit inside the USB shell, an inline enclosure or a molded body. This changes the engineering scope: chip identity, oscillator and buffer behavior, USB descriptors, power state, I/O voltage, protection and thermal limits join the cable, connector and strain-relief requirements.
copy.zh: USB 转串行线在主机端接收 USB 数据，通过接口芯片转换，再在设备端提供 UART 或其他串行电气接口。电子器件可能位于 USB 外壳、线中盒或包胶体内部。工程范围因此不再只是线材和接口，还包括芯片身份、时钟与缓冲行为、USB 描述符、供电状态、I/O 电平、防护与热边界。

title.en: Choose the Bridge by Channel, Handshake and Throughput
title.zh: 按通道、握手与吞吐选择桥接芯片

copy.en: FT232R, FT230X, FT231X and FT234XD families address single-channel UART needs with different modem-control and configurable I/O resources; FT2232H and FT4232H families support multiple channels or higher-speed interface modes. The selected part must match required TXD, RXD, RTS, CTS, DTR, DSR or CBUS functions, baud range, latency expectations, package space and lifecycle. A family name is not a released BOM, and we do not imply authorized or genuine-device supply unless the sourcing route is agreed and documented.
copy.zh: FT232R、FT230X、FT231X 与 FT234XD 家族面向不同的单通道 UART、调制解调器握手与可配置 I/O 需求；FT2232H、FT4232H 家族可支持多通道或更高速接口模式。选型应匹配 TXD、RXD、RTS、CTS、DTR、DSR 或 CBUS 功能、波特率、延迟预期、封装空间与生命周期。芯片家族名称不是放行 BOM；除非采购路径经过约定并有文件证明，我们不会泛化宣称授权或正品来源。

title.en: TTL UART, RS-232, RS-422 and RS-485 Are Not Interchangeable
title.zh: TTL UART、RS-232、RS-422 与 RS-485 不能混用

copy.en: UART names the data format at a logic interface; it does not define every physical voltage. A 3.3 V or 5 V TTL-level lead is not a direct substitute for bipolar RS-232, differential RS-422 or multipoint RS-485. The target transceiver, idle polarity, common reference, termination, bias network, duplex mode and isolation policy determine the electronics. Before production, the drawing states both the logical signal and the electrical layer instead of calling every product an FTDI serial cable.
copy.zh: UART 描述逻辑接口的数据格式，并不定义所有物理电压。3.3 V 或 5 V TTL 电平线不能直接替代双极性 RS-232、差分 RS-422 或多点 RS-485。目标收发器、空闲极性、公共参考、终端、偏置网络、单双工模式与隔离策略共同决定电路。生产前，图纸会同时写明逻辑信号与电气层，而不是把所有产品都笼统称为 FTDI 串口线。

title.en: Pinout, Direction and Handshake Must Be Frozen
title.zh: 针脚、方向与握手信号必须冻结

copy.en: TX and RX are named from a device perspective, so two drawings can use opposite-looking labels for the same link. Ground, VCC, VCCIO, RTS, CTS, DTR, DSR and reset or boot-control lines may also be present. We confirm the mating-face view, signal direction, active level, unused contacts, shell or shield connection and equipment-side pin numbering. Color alone is not an electrical specification, especially for RJ45 console leads and proprietary headers.
copy.zh: TX 与 RX 通常从设备视角命名，因此两份图纸可能用看似相反的标签描述同一链路。回路还可能包含 GND、VCC、VCCIO、RTS、CTS、DTR、DSR，以及复位或启动控制线。我们会确认插合面视图、信号方向、有效电平、未用触点、外壳或屏蔽连接与设备端编号。线色不能替代电气规范，尤其是在 RJ45 控制台线与专用排针中。

title.en: USB, Header, RJ45, DB9, M8/M12 and Loose-Wire Endpoints

copy.en: The host side may use USB-A, USB-C, Micro-B or a captive board connection. The serial side can terminate in a 2.54 mm or 2.00 mm header, JST- or Molex-style housing, RJ45/8P8C console plug, DE-9/DB9, M8/M12 circular connector, audio-style plug, panel bulkhead or prepared wires. Each build needs the real mating part, keying, orientation, shell, retention, panel envelope and service route; connector names alone do not establish compatibility.
copy.zh: 主机侧可采用 USB-A、USB-C、Micro-B 或板端固定连接；串行侧可连接 2.54 mm/2.00 mm 排针、JST 或 Molex 类壳体、RJ45/8P8C 控制台插头、DE-9/DB9、M8/M12 圆形接口、音频式插头、面板转接或预处理散线。每种结构都要核对真实对插件、防呆、方向、外壳、锁止、面板包络与维护路径，接口名称本身不能证明兼容。

title.en: Driver, USB Identity and Application API Belong to the Product
title.zh: 驱动、USB 身份与应用 API 都属于产品定义

copy.en: FTDI devices can operate through Virtual COM Port drivers or the D2XX direct interface, depending on the device and application. Operating-system support, signed-driver policy, VID/PID, serial number, product string, latency settings and any EEPROM configuration can affect deployment and service. The customer should define whether software expects a COM port, a specific FTDI API, a fixed device identity or multiple simultaneous units. Programming records and a functional check are added when configuration is part of the supplied assembly.
copy.zh: FTDI 器件可根据设备与应用使用虚拟串口 VCP 驱动或 D2XX 直接接口。操作系统支持、签名驱动策略、VID/PID、序列号、产品字符串、延迟设置及 EEPROM 配置都会影响部署与维护。客户应说明软件需要 COM 端口、特定 FTDI API、固定设备身份，还是多个单元同时工作；若交付组件包含配置，还应加入编程记录与功能检查。

title.en: Protect the Host, Converter and Field Interface Separately
title.zh: 主机、转换器与现场接口要分层保护

copy.en: A field cable can carry electrostatic discharge, ground offset, induced noise or accidental voltage toward the USB host. Protection may include series impedance, transient suppression, filtering, galvanic isolation or an external RS-232/RS-485 transceiver, but each choice changes signal margin, power, heat and enclosure space. Shield, drain, USB shell, signal ground and chassis are connected according to the equipment grounding architecture rather than one universal recipe.
copy.zh: 现场线缆可能把静电、地电位差、感应噪声或误接电压带向 USB 主机。保护可包括串联阻抗、瞬态抑制、滤波、电气隔离，或外置 RS-232/RS-485 收发器，但每项选择都会改变信号裕量、功耗、温升与封装空间。屏蔽、排流线、USB 外壳、信号地与机壳地应服从设备接地架构，不存在适用于所有系统的固定接法。

title.en: Cable Structure and Molding Must Protect the Electronics
title.zh: 线缆结构与包胶要保护内部电子器件

copy.en: Conductor size follows current, voltage drop, terminal range and cable length; signal pairs, shield coverage and jacket follow noise, flexing, abrasion, oils and installation. The electronics enclosure or molded head needs controlled component clearance, support, adhesion, venting, thermal path and a progressive strain-relief transition. A larger, harder boot may look robust while transferring bending into the PCB or first solder joint, so installed route and pull direction are reviewed before tooling.
copy.zh: 导体规格依据电流、压降、端子范围与长度选择，信号线对、屏蔽覆盖和护套则结合噪声、弯曲、磨损、油污与安装环境审核。电子器件外壳或包胶头需要控制元件间隙、支撑、粘接、排气、散热路径与渐进式应力过渡。更大更硬的尾套看似坚固，却可能把弯曲传到 PCB 或第一处焊点，因此开模前要结合装机路径与拉力方向审核。

title.en: Programming, Service, Instrumentation and Industrial Control
title.zh: 编程、维修、仪器与工业控制应用

copy.en: Custom USB-to-UART and USB-to-serial assemblies are used for microcontroller programming, boot-console access, laboratory instruments, data loggers, industrial controllers, service tools, CNC and automation equipment, network-console access and embedded product setup. These uses differ in voltage, pinout, software, isolation, connector retention and duty cycle. Equipment model, firmware mode and representative host behavior should be included in sample validation.
copy.zh: 定制 USB-UART 与 USB 串行组件可用于微控制器编程、启动控制台、实验室仪器、数据记录器、工业控制器、维修工具、CNC 与自动化设备、网络控制台和嵌入式产品设置。这些应用在电平、针脚、软件、隔离、接口保持与工况上差异很大；样品验证应包含设备型号、固件模式与代表性主机行为。

title.en: Validate Wiring, Voltage, Enumeration and Real Data Transfer
title.zh: 同时验证接线、电平、枚举与真实数据传输

copy.en: Production inspection begins with continuity, shorts, polarity, conductor resistance, shield and shell paths, dimensions, labels and molding condition. Active assemblies add USB enumeration, descriptor or serial-number checks, I/O voltage, quiescent current and representative send/receive tests at agreed settings. Where risk requires it, ESD, isolation, temperature, flex, pull or system-level tests are defined separately. A loopback result does not prove compatibility with every device, driver or serial network.
copy.zh: 生产检验从导通、短路、极性、导体电阻、屏蔽与外壳路径、尺寸、标签与包胶状态开始。有源组件还要增加 USB 枚举、描述符或序列号、I/O 电平、静态电流，以及在约定设置下的代表性收发测试；项目风险需要时，再单独定义 ESD、隔离、温度、弯曲、拉力或系统测试。一次回环测试不能证明兼容所有设备、驱动或串行网络。

inputs.en: Host USB connector, operating system, driver route and application/API behavior
inputs.zh: 主机 USB 接口、操作系统、驱动路径与应用/API 行为

inputs.en: Target equipment model, mating connector, mating-face view and exact pin map
inputs.zh: 目标设备型号、对插件、插合面视图与准确针脚表

inputs.en: TTL UART, RS-232, RS-422 or RS-485 layer, I/O voltage and required handshake lines
inputs.zh: TTL UART、RS-232、RS-422 或 RS-485 电气层、I/O 电平与握手信号

inputs.en: Power source, allowable current, grounding, shield, isolation and transient protection
inputs.zh: 供电来源、允许电流、接地、屏蔽、隔离与瞬态保护

inputs.en: Length, cable route, flexing, pull, temperature, fluids, enclosure and molding needs
inputs.zh: 长度、走线、弯曲、拉力、温度、介质、外壳与包胶需求

inputs.en: Chip or functional requirement, sourcing control, quantity, labels and validation limits
inputs.zh: 芯片或功能要求、采购控制、数量、标签与验证限值

q.en: Is an FTDI cable the same as a passive USB cable?
q.zh: FTDI 线和普通被动 USB 线一样吗？

a.en: No. It contains USB-to-serial conversion electronics and may include configuration, level translation and protection. The assembly must be controlled as an electronic product.
a.zh: 不一样。它包含 USB 转串行电子器件，并可能包含配置、电平转换与保护，需要按电子产品控制。

q.en: Can one cable switch between 3.3 V TTL, 5 V TTL and RS-232?
q.zh: 一条线可以随意在 3.3 V TTL、5 V TTL 与 RS-232 间通用吗？

a.en: Not unless the electronics are specifically designed and documented for those modes. Logic-level UART and RS-232 use different electrical layers; incorrect connection can prevent operation or damage equipment.
a.zh: 除非电路专门设计并明确记录这些模式，否则不能。逻辑电平 UART 与 RS-232 使用不同电气层，误接可能导致无法工作或损坏设备。

q.en: Can the serial end use RJ45, DB9, M12 or a custom connector?
q.zh: 串行端可以做成 RJ45、DB9、M12 或专用接口吗？

a.en: Yes. Compatibility depends on the exact mating part, pin map, electrical layer, orientation, retention and environment—not the connector name alone.
a.zh: 可以。兼容性取决于准确对插件、针脚、电气层、方向、锁止与环境，而不是只看接口名称。

q.en: Do you program VID/PID, serial numbers or EEPROM settings?
q.zh: 可以写入 VID/PID、序列号或 EEPROM 配置吗？

a.en: Configuration can be included when the approved device, ownership and programming data are supplied and the required verification is agreed. We do not invent or reuse another party's identifiers.
a.zh: 在批准器件、标识归属与编程数据齐全且验证方法约定后，可以纳入配置；我们不会擅自编造或复用他方标识。

q.en: Does continuity testing prove an FTDI cable works?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明 FTDI 线正常工作吗？

a.en: No. Continuity verifies the passive circuit. An active cable also needs appropriate enumeration, voltage and data-function checks with a defined host and load or fixture.
a.zh: 不能。导通只验证被动回路；有源线还需要在规定主机与负载或夹具上检查枚举、电平与数据功能。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: FTDI 电缆组件报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send the target equipment, both endpoints, pin map, serial electrical standard, voltage, signals, driver/application requirement, power and protection policy, cable mechanics, quantity and validation method.
a.zh: 请提供目标设备、两端接口、针脚表、串行电气标准、电平、信号、驱动/应用要求、供电与防护策略、线缆机械需求、数量和验证方法。
